81:t_1:86.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh, no! Now I've only earned 70 en today!」

81:t_1:87.en:
$$店長$$
「Every single day, you break plates and frying pans, and last week, even the refrigerator... People don't normally break refrigerators.」

81:t_1:88.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Breaking things is the one thing I'm good at.」

81:t_1:89.en:
$$店長$$
「Do you want to go back to the country and chop firewood?」

81:t_1:90.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I can't just split like that... Besides... I don't even know what's happened to my hometown...」

81:t_1:91.en:
$$店長$$
「...You're right. I never imagined my restaurant on Mars would be flung to Earth, either.」

81:t_1:92.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$ will overcome any hardship! With hard work and guts...!」

81:t_1:93.en:
$$店長$$
「...You're still young, $$ノノ$$, so you might not understand...」

81:t_1:94.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Um... Are commercial refrigerators really that expensive?」

81:t_1:95.en:
$$店長$$
「Of course they are. You'll be working for free for the next six months...」

81:t_1:97.en:
$$店長$$
「Anyway, a space pilot, was it...? Stop chasing flighty dreams and start taking your job seriously.」

81:t_1:99.en:
$$店長$$
「It's been about six months since we were both flung into this world... We have to put surviving first.」

81:t_1:100.en:
$$店長$$
「This job may be a far cry from being a space pilot, but no other place will give you room and board.」

81:t_1:102.en:
$$店長$$
「Besides, those space pilots you look up to might not even exist in this world...」

81:t_1:103.en:
$$店長$$
「And this town... No, this whole planet could be gone tomorrow.」

81:t_1:109.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「If we'd been assigned to $$セントラル・ベース$$, we wouldn't have had to come to a backwater like this.」

81:t_1:112.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「That's right, little girl. We're $$サイデリアル$$... The rulers of this planet.」

81:t_1:113.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「We're here to oversee the $$レイライン$$ near this town. You'll be looking after us for a while.」

81:t_1:114.en:
$$店長$$
「Y-Yes. To celebrate your first visit, your drinks are on the house today.」

81:t_1:115.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「That woman knows her place, at least.」

81:t_1:117.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, little girl. $$サイデリアル$$ doesn't rule this town directly because it isn't worth the trouble.」

81:t_1:118.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「In other words, nobody would care if this worthless town burned to ashes or whatever.」

81:t_1:120.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「And naturally, nobody would care if the town lost one resident.」

81:t_1:121.en:
$$店長$$
「I'm terribly sorry, sir...! This girl doesn't know her manners...!」

81:t_1:122.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「You stay out of this.」

81:t_1:123.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「I don't like the look in this brat's eyes.」

81:t_1:124.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Earthlings are a strange species. No matter how badly we hurt you, you never stop resisting...」

81:t_1:125.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「You'd be hard-pressed to find such a bizarre species anywhere else in the galaxy.」

81:t_1:126.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're the ones I don't like! If you think violence lets you do whatever you want, you're terribly wrong!」

81:t_1:127.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「What did you say?」

81:t_1:128.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ knows how much trouble you've been causing the people here.」

81:t_1:129.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Get out of this restaurant... and this town! We won't serve you so much as a drop of water!」

81:t_1:135.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「What? Some little squirt just showed up.」

81:t_1:136.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're the ones who are small-minded.」

81:t_1:137.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「You've got a big mouth! You must really want to die!」

81:t_1:138.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「W-Wait! That thing on her forehead...」

81:t_2:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

81:t_2:4.en:
$$レイカ$$
「...It's a pleasure to meet you, Captain $$ジェフリー$$. My name is $$三条レイカ$$.」

81:t_2:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'm Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$, captain of the $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」

81:t_2:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our sister ship, the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, is conducting diversionary operations in the Pacific, so I'm currently commanding $c.」

81:t_2:7.en:
$$レイカ$$
「$$破嵐$$ has told me about your achievements.」

81:t_2:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「He's saved all of us many times. Miss $$三条$$... I'll be counting on you, too.」

81:t_2:9.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Please call me $$レイカ$$. Since we share the same goals, I'll accompany your unit and offer my assistance.」

81:t_2:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh... You're putting on airs, Sis $$レイカ$$...」

81:t_2:11.en:
$$レイカ$$
「$$ビューティ$$ couldn't handle this sort of thing, could she?」

81:t_2:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're really working hard for your beloved Big Bro $$万丈$$.」

81:t_2:13.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's $$万丈$$ for you! I didn't know he had such a beautiful assistant...!」

81:t_2:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sis $$レイカ$$ isn't his only assistant. His other one, Sis $$ビューティ$$, has one hell of a rack.」

81:t_2:15.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Why, $$勝平$$. My figure's just as good as $$ビューティ$$'s.」

81:t_2:18.en:
$$郁絵$$
「President, $$勝平$$, Captain $$ジェフリー$$ is hearing her out on our behalf. Please don't interrupt.」

81:t_2:20.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So... Where is $$万丈$$ now?」

81:t_2:21.en:
$$レイカ$$
「I'm sorry. He's apart from us at the moment, taking care of some personal business.」

81:t_2:22.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Knowing him, I doubt we need to worry.」

81:t_2:23.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$レイカ$$... Do you know about the $$トップレス$$?」

81:t_2:24.en:
$$レイカ$$
「I've heard they're a special team devoted to fighting $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

81:t_2:25.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Damn... I thought I'd get to hear a sexy answer from a beautiful woman...)

81:t_2:27.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Their world was also transported here by the $$時空震動$$, but...」
